• Strong administrative and organizational skills.

The client is a leading international industrial organization operating in a complex, high-volume manufacturing environment, with a strong focus on operational excellence, continuous improvement, and supply chain performance.

• Demonstrated leadership and people-management capabilities, with the ability to motivate teams and manage both permanent and temporary workforce populations.

jobs.occupation: Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2)
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international organisation with a strong reputation for operational excellence and a people-focused culture. 

To strengthen its local IT presence in Belgium, our client is looking for a service-oriented IT professional who enjoys working in a collaborative and multicultural environment. The organisation promotes knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development while offering employees the opportunity to work closely with both local and international teams.

Jobomschrijving

As a Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2), your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first and second-line IT support to end users.
• Managing incidents, service requests, and technical queries in line with established processes and service level agreements.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and Microsoft 365-related issues.
• Acting as the primary local IT point of contact for employees based in Belgium.
• Logging, tracking, documenting, and resolving tickets using the company's IT Service Management platform.
• Collaborating with international IT teams, vendors, and specialist support teams to resolve complex issues.
• Monitoring IT systems and escalating recurring or critical issues when required.
• Supporting IT projects, deployments, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
• Managing employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware preparation, account setup, and access management.
• Supporting meeting room technology, printers, audiovisual equipment, and local IT infrastructure.
• Creating and maintaining user documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational procedures.
• Identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance service quality, and optimise the overall user experience.

The successful candidate will have:

• At least 2/3 years of experience in an IT Support, Service Desk, or End User Support role.
• Fluency in English & Dutch. French is a plus. 
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, end-user computing, networking fundamentals, and IT security best practices.
• Experience managing incidents, service requests, and change-related activities.
• Hands-on experience with Active Directory and Microsoft 365 user administration.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to resolve technical issues independently.
• Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
• The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.

ITIL, Microsoft, or other relevant certifications would be considered an advantage.

On a personal level, you are recognised for your customer-centric mindset, team spirit, adaptability, and willingness to continuously learn and improve. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvements, and delivering an outstanding support experience to end users.

Our client is a globally renowned law firm with an outstanding reputation across the UK, the US, and international markets. With offices located worldwide, the firm advises leading multinational organizations on complex legal matters across various industries.

Due to continued growth of the Brussels office and an upcoming move to larger premises early next year, the firm is looking to strengthen its support team with an additional Legal Assistant. You will join a collaborative environment and work closely with another experienced Legal Assistant in a duo setup, ensuring seamless support to the legal team.

Legal & Administrative Support

• Follow up on billing queries and liaise with lawyers and finance teams when needed.
• Prepare, format, proofread, and finalize legal documents, presentations, and correspondence.

Reception Support (10%)

jobs.occupation: CE truck driver for national transport - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

jobs.occupation: Order picker in night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!
